universe: existing cached TOP_100 disclosure universe; no 2026
feature_sources: cached disclosure metadata and primary public SEC/issuer sources only; numerical facts retained; inaccessible sources excluded
comparison: Each 2025 regular annual meeting versus latest 2024 regular annual meeting of same issuer; exclude special meetings and duplicate tags.

features.say_on_pay_dissent: 100 * Against/(For+Against), excluding abstention and broker nonvotes; comparable nonbinding executive compensation resolution only
features.director_dissent: 100 * unweighted mean across all director candidates of Against-or-Withheld/(For+Against-or-Withheld); require comparable voting method and economic voting units; report board composition change as caveat

score: (2025 say-on-pay dissent minus 2024 say-on-pay dissent) minus (2025 board-wide mean director dissent minus 2024 board-wide mean director dissent), in percentage points
event_rule: score >= 10.0 percentage points; single pay-specific net-dissent hypothesis
control_rule: Both pay and director dissent channels measured in both years and score <10.0pp
exclusions: incomparable voting denominator or class totals
missing say-on-pay vote in either year
holdout: No return or price lookup; root performs predeclared central pricing

amendment_history.reason: Parent clarified exact user-promised net pay-specific dissent score before any outcomes or option prices were read; initial OR interpretation was incorrect.
amendment_history.prior_score: max(2025 minus 2024 say-on-pay dissent pp, 2025 minus 2024 matched-director mean dissent pp) across available comparable channels
amendment_history.prior_event_rule: score >= 10.0 percentage points; predeclared two-channel OR; record each channel; no tuning
